# Muhammet Enes Gül

Muhammet Enes Gül is a recent Computer Engineering graduate and software engineer focused on building reliable, high-performance software. His interests include backend systems, distributed systems, developer tooling, open-source software, and applied AI.

This site is a personal portfolio containing projects, technical notes, writing, weekly engineering logs, and career background.

- About: /about

## Featured projects

- Far Away from Codex: /projects/far-away-from-codex
  Developer tooling for coding-agent attention, notifications, approvals, and remote interaction flows.

- AI Carbon Tracking: /projects/ai-carbon-tracking
  TÜBİTAK 2209-A funded project combining mobile development, backend services, Firebase, and AI-assisted analysis.

- URL Shortener: /projects/url-shortener
  Distributed systems learning project using Flask, PostgreSQL, Redis, NGINX, Docker, replicas, rate limiting, and k6.

## Open source

- Oracle OpenGrok: /projects/oracle-opengrok
  Contribution improving Bazaar repository tests to exercise real bzr behavior. The pull request is currently open.
